title: O God of Vengeance, Shine Forth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public courtyard in an ancient Israelite town where wealthy and influential men sit together while poor residents stand outside the circle seeking a hearing. One powerful man gestures dismissively toward a widow, and another turns away from an orphan whose family needs protection. Their faces express arrogance, as though no one can call them to account. At the edge of the courtyard, an Israelite worshipper raises his hands in prayer, asking the LORD to reveal His justice and not allow the proud to triumph indefinitely. A stone bench and the gate of the town create a realistic setting for local judgment. In the background, several honest elders look troubled by the treatment of the vulnerable and quietly prepare to hear their concerns. The image should express the psalm's accusation that the wicked crush God's people and claim that the LORD does not see or understand, without depicting violence or making a specific historical accusation. Ancient clothing, limestone architecture, woven baskets, natural daylight. No modern courtroom objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Knows the Thoughts of Humanity
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite teacher sits beneath a tree beside a settlement, instructing a group of adults and young learners about wisdom, correction, and the limits of human understanding. Behind them, an arrogant official boasts that no one knows what he is doing, while an honest witness quietly reveals that the official has been treating the poor unfairly. The contrast should demonstrate that the God who made the ear hears and the God who made the eye sees, expressed through ordinary human senses rather than a visible divine figure. A small stream flows past the tree and fields stretch toward distant hills, grounding the conversation in the everyday life of the community. The learners listen thoughtfully as the teacher explains that correction can bring rest to the righteous and that the LORD will not abandon His people or forsake His inheritance. Realistic ancient garments, stone dwellings, a shaded tree, and natural light. No modern classroom furniture, printed materials, or fantasy imagery.

title: The LORD Is My Defense and Refuge
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper stands beside a rugged stone refuge overlooking a valley. Behind him, several powerful men have spread misleading accusations and are speaking together near the town gate. A local elder considers their statements while a truthful witness waits patiently. The worshipper turns toward the sky in prayer, remembering that he would have faltered without the LORD's help and that God's consolations bring delight even amid inward troubles. The high rock beside him serves as a natural visual metaphor for defense and refuge. In the distance, the dishonest officials' gathering begins to break apart as their claims fail to gain support, but no one is punished violently. The scene should emphasize that God does not abandon the righteous and that justice ultimately belongs to Him. Use historically plausible clothing, limestone terrain, stone walls, and calm natural daylight. No modern legal symbols, readable documents, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: Come, Let Us Sing to the Rock of Our Salvation
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a joyful gathering of ancient Israelites approaches a sanctuary courtyard with musical instruments and simple offerings of thanksgiving. Men, women, and children sing together, and several musicians play lyres and hand drums. An elder gestures toward the surrounding hills and waters, acknowledging the LORD as the great King who holds the depths of the earth and the heights of the mountains in His authority. Nearby, shepherds guide a flock toward green pasture, illustrating the psalm's description of God's people as the sheep of His hand. The sanctuary and gathering should feel modest, historically plausible, and reverent. The composition conveys gratitude, joyful worship, and the recognition that the earth belongs to its Creator. Avoid portraying God as a literal shepherd visible in the sky. Authentic ancient Israelite garments, realistic animals, natural landscape, and warm daylight. No modern instruments, printed words, or fantasy effects.

title: Harden Not Your Hearts
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a wilderness encampment during Israel's remembered journey through dry country. In the foreground, several Israelites stand around a rocky spring, arguing anxiously about the availability of water. Some gesture in frustration toward Moses and other elders, while others look toward the empty horizon with concern. An older leader kneels near the spring, testing the water and praying, while families wait beside their tents. The wider landscape recalls the wilderness experiences of Meribah and Massah, where the people tested God despite having witnessed His works. Do not depict a supernatural punishment or claim this is a specific moment unless the chronology is explicitly established. The image should convey the warning not to harden one's heart when God calls, contrasting impatient demands with the posture of listening and trust. Historically plausible Israelite tents, water jars, garments, rocky terrain, and natural sunlight. No modern equipment, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Sing a New Song to the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an open courtyard in ancient Israel filled with worshippers singing a new song of praise. A group of musicians plays lyres, hand drums, and simple wind instruments while families and travelers listen and join the song. Some visitors wear clothing from distant regions of the ancient Near East, suggesting that God's glory and wonderful works are not limited to one village. A singer stands near the center, lifting one hand toward the sky and the other toward the gathered people, encouraging all the earth to bless the LORD's name and declare His salvation from day to day. In the background, the sanctuary stands above the settlement, and sunlight illuminates the stone walls and surrounding hills. The mood should express joyful proclamation, reverence, and the beauty of holiness. Avoid a modern concert aesthetic or an imagined historical gathering of every nation at once. Authentic ancient instruments and garments, realistic architecture, natural lighting. No modern audio systems, stage lights, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Let the Heavens Rejoice and the Earth Be Glad
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a wide panoramic view of the ancient Near Eastern landscape beneath a brilliant sky. In the foreground, worshippers arrive at a sanctuary with humble gifts and expressions of reverence. Beyond them, farmers work in cultivated fields, trees sway in a gentle breeze, the sea moves against the coast, and birds rise above the hills. The varied elements of creation appear as natural witnesses to the LORD's kingship and coming judgment. A group of elders speaks with travelers near the city gate about God's justice, while children look across the landscape with wonder. The image should reflect the psalm's universal summons for heaven, earth, sea, fields, and trees to rejoice because the LORD comes to judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in truth. Do not portray the trees as human-like figures or depict a supernatural judge descending visibly from the sky. Use realistic ancient architecture, agriculture, water, and natural light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy creatures.

title: The LORD Reigns; Clouds and Darkness Surround Him
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with dramatic but believable storm imagery. A broad landscape of ancient Israel lies beneath heavy clouds, with dark mist around distant mountains and lightning flashing near the horizon. In the foreground, worshippers stand on a rocky rise, looking across the land with awe as they reflect on the LORD's sovereignty and righteousness. A fortified city sits on a distant hill, while the surrounding countryside remains still. The storm and flashes of lightning symbolize divine majesty, the fire that goes before the LORD in the psalm's poetry, and the earth responding to God's presence. Do not depict God as a human shape among the clouds, and do not turn the scene into a literal supernatural attack. The mood should be majestic and solemn, with the sky and mountains dominating the composition. Historically plausible ancient garments, rocky terrain, natural storm clouds, and realistic lightning. No modern buildings, fantasy bolts with faces, or written captions.

title: Rejoice in the LORD, You Righteous
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite community gathers in a courtyard after hearing a declaration of God's righteous reign. Some people turn away from carved objects associated with false worship, while others raise their hands in thanksgiving. Near the entrance, an elder explains the importance of reverence and the joy of those who love the LORD and hate evil. In the background, Zion and the surrounding hills catch the late-afternoon light, while distant settlements suggest that the LORD's judgment and justice extend beyond one city. A family helps an elderly neighbor prepare a simple meal, showing that righteousness is reflected in ordinary kindness as well as worship. The scene should communicate joy, protection, and gratitude without portraying the psalm's divine judgment as a literal visible figure or violent event. title: Sing to the LORD a New Song

title: The Rivers Clap Their Hands
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with poetic landscape imagery, a broad river winds through a fertile ancient Near Eastern valley toward the sea. Trees line the banks, fields stretch into the distance, and mountains rise beneath a clear sky. In the foreground, an Israelite family stands on a rocky rise watching the water, while children clap their hands joyfully and an elder lifts his face in praise. The natural movement of the river, rustling trees, and rolling hills symbolizes the psalm's poetic invitation for rivers to clap their hands and mountains to sing together before the LORD. Do not animate the landscape literally or turn the natural world into fantasy creatures. The image should express the whole creation's rejoicing that the LORD comes to judge the world with righteousness and equity. Use realistic water, local vegetation, ancient garments, and natural sunlight. No modern bridges, vehicles, captions, or supernatural effects.

title: The LORD Reigns; Let the Peoples Tremble
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite sanctuary courtyard in a solemn moment of worship. In the background, Zion rises above the city and travelers stand near the gate, looking toward the sanctuary with awe. title: Moses, Aaron, and Samuel Called upon the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a symbolic historical tableau connecting three generations of faithful leaders in Israel's history. In the foreground, Moses stands near the wilderness camp with a staff, Aaron stands near a modest sanctuary entrance wearing historically plausible priestly garments, and Samuel appears as a younger worshipper beside a place of prayer. Their figures are arranged in connected spaces within one broad landscape rather than appearing together as a literal historical meeting. Families and elders gather nearby, remembering how these servants called upon the LORD and received answers, while also recognizing that God forgave and corrected His people. In the background, a rugged mountain, a wilderness path, and a sanctuary courtyard represent the different settings of their ministries. The scene should express intercession, divine response, and the LORD's holiness. Avoid anachronistic garments or elaborate later temple architecture. Use authentic ancient Near Eastern clothing, realistic landscape, natural light, and restrained composition. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Enter His Gates with Thanksgiving
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a joyful gathering of ancient Israelites approaches the gates of a sanctuary with songs of thanksgiving. Families walk together, worshippers raise their hands, and musicians play lyres and hand drums. Some children smile as they follow their parents through the open stone gateway. In the foreground, an elder welcomes a tired traveler and guides him toward the courtyard, reflecting the joyful invitation for all lands to serve the LORD with gladness. Beyond the gate, simple stone buildings, woven curtains, and a modest altar area create a historically plausible Israelite worship setting. The atmosphere is warm, grateful, and communal. The composition should express that the LORD made His people, that they belong to Him, and that His goodness, mercy, and faithfulness endure through generations. Avoid a modern church entrance or a monumental temple from a later period unless chronologically appropriate. Use realistic garments, stonework, natural sunlight, and expressive faces. No modern objects, readable signs, or fantasy effects.
